Act10-2#2.zh: 喂！发生什么事了！振作一点。
Act10-2#2.t: Hey! What happened? Pull yourself together.

Act10-2#4.t: Oh no! The birthday gifts! ...Ah... my head hurts...

Act10-2#5.zh: 生，生辰纲不见了！这可是要杀头的啊！我不要死！
Act10-2#5.t: The, the birthday gifts are gone! That means our heads! I don't want to die!

Act10-2#6.zh: 我，我也不要死！我要回家种田！
Act10-2#6.t: M-me neither! I want to go home and farm!

Act10-2#7.zh: 唉...没想到堂堂名门之后，居然落得如此下场...看来我也只有一死了...
Act10-2#7.t: Sigh... who'd have thought a descendant of a famous house would come to this... It seems all that's left for me is death...

Act10-2#8.zh: 镇静一点！没有什么事是不能解决的！到底发生了什么事！
Act10-2#8.t: Calm down! There's nothing that can't be solved! What on earth happened?

Act10-2#9.zh: 唉...现在告诉你也无妨。我是三代将门之后，人称『杨家将』中五侯杨令公之孙，姓杨，名志。
Act10-2#9.t: Sigh... no harm in telling you now. I come from three generations of generals, grandson of Lord Yang of the Five Marquises of the 'Yang Family Generals'. My name is Yang Zhi.

Act10-2#10.zh: 莫非人称『青面兽』的杨志？为何流落至此？
Act10-2#10.t: Could you be Yang Zhi, the 'Blue-faced Beast'? How did you end up like this?

Act10-2#11.zh: 在下运气其差无比。当初虽然中过武举，在朝廷为官；却因运送皇帝的『花石纲』时，遇上大风浪打翻了一船货物，只能四处流浪。后来在街上自卫杀了一个流氓『没毛大虫』牛二，被刺配北京大名府充军。蒙恩相梁中书提拔，押送给蔡太师祝寿的『生辰纲』往东京；结果却在刚才被人给抢了！不如我一死以谢罪！
Act10-2#11.t: My luck is as bad as it gets. I passed the military examination and served the court, but while shipping the Emperor's 'Rock Convoy' a great storm capsized a boat of cargo, and I had to wander. Later, in self-defence, I killed a street thug, 'Hairless Tiger' Niu Er, and was branded and exiled to the army at Daming Prefecture in the Northern Capital. Secretary Liang favoured me and sent me to escort the 'birthday gifts' for Grand Tutor Cai to the Eastern Capital, and just now they were robbed! I'd better die to atone!

Act10-2#12.zh: 杨兄生得仪表堂堂，亦有十八般武艺在身，不想为国尽忠，却只一心寻死？岂不丢杨家忠义之名？
Act10-2#12.t: Brother Yang, you're a man of fine bearing, skilled in all eighteen arms. Instead of serving your country loyally, you only want to die? Wouldn't that shame the Yang family's name for loyalty?

Act10-2#13.zh: 对啊！哪个山头的毛贼敢抢杨兄弟的生辰纲，洒家第一个带头杀进去！把生辰纲抢回来不就没事了吗！
Act10-2#13.t: Right! Whatever hill's petty thieves dared rob Brother Yang's birthday gifts, I'll be the first to charge in! Get the gifts back and everything's fine!

Act10-2#14.zh: 杨志无能，竟然劳动尊驾相助；敢问诸位大名？
Act10-2#14.t: I, Yang Zhi, am useless, yet you would trouble yourselves to help me. May I ask your names?

Act10-2#15.zh: 众人彼此互通名号，自我介绍一番。
Act10-2#15.t: They all exchanged names and introduced themselves.

Act10-2#16.zh: %X兄，这一带势力最大的强盗窝可以说是『二龙山』了。咱们何不去那里探探消息？
Act10-2#16.t: Brother %X, the biggest bandit lair around here is 'Twin Dragon Mountain'. Why don't we go there and find out?

Act10-2#17.zh: 说得也对；我们就先上『二龙山』吧！
Act10-2#17.t: You're right. Let's head up 'Twin Dragon Mountain' first!
